subclassPaths: A wholly defended move while authored Guard/Ward holds grants one Shelter token; next chosen Attack can spend it for an offensive bonus. Once/move, both defence styles work.
Brace can grant a small Ward after the defended move, once/cast. Sunder may trade part of its damage for one enemy opportunity of Weaken.
A gross signature expenditure or the third consecutive basic Attack grants Edge of Battle: the next chosen basic Attack adds one Bleed. One token, no hit-taking requirement.
Cleave can consume part of existing Bleed for immediate derived damage. Heavy Strike can trade Opening's damage bonus for a short Guard after contact.
First authored resource-spending directly damaging active per hero opportunity adds one Venom; visible five-stack/tick ceiling. Genuine poison, not a renamed Bleed modifier.
Barbed Strike can apply Venom instead of Bleed. Quarry Mark can trade duration for a Venom payoff; neither creates a second poison packet per hit.
Fully defending a move earns Route: next Attack Pins the foe. One token, mixed Parry/Dodge permitted.
Pinning Strike can trade some damage for one-opportunity Guard. Lunge-equivalent Footwork variant of Power Strike trades heavy damage for standard damage and modest Speed.
Alternating damage types, or spell → Attack, primes a modest follow-up bonus. One per action; same-type spam does not earn it.
Frost Shard may consume one Burn tick for a bounded frost payoff. Nova can use the previous spell's damage type instead of holy, without copying its status payload.
An authored Ward naturally ending/breaking gives Warmth: next chosen Attack/spell has a bounded offensive bonus. One token; not reflected damage.
Arcane Ward can trade size for blocking one incoming status. Spark can trade some damage for a small Ward after its hit.
growth: Warden
Wholly defend under authored Guard/Ward for one Shelter; spend on a chosen Attack. Brace may exchange some Guard duration for a small Ward.
**Stand Fast:** Shelter strengthens Attack. **Give Ground:** Shelter instead restores a small Ward, replacing under the cap. Sunder gains an optional damage-for-Weaken variant.
**Answer the Siege:** transfer one Shelter to a chosen heavy active instead of Attack. **Keep the Door:** once/fight spend Shelter to block one incoming status, losing its offensive payoff.
Reaver
A gross signature expenditure or third consecutive Attack primes one next-Attack wound. Cleave may release one existing Bleed tick instead of adding two stacks.

**Open the Wound:** consume one authored tick on chosen Attack. **Keep It Open:** retain wounds and let the next signature spender grant short Guard instead. Heavy Strike's variant trades damage for the protected release.

**Decisive End:** once/fight transfer a prepared wound payoff to one heavy active. **Long Pursuit:** once/fight preserve that wound's duration instead of its release damage. No duplicated consumed tick.
Venomstalker
First resource-spending directly damaging active adds one Venom/action. Barbed Strike can poison instead of Bleed.

**Slow Toxin:** refresh duration but add no stack on the optional poison variant. **Distil:** consume a stack for a capped one-unit return, within the common refund budget. Quarry Mark gains a short-Mark/poison conversion.

**Leave a Trace:** once/fight retain one stack instead of counting its consumed damage. **Clean Extraction:** once/fight take a small bounded heal instead of the selected poison consumption's direct bonus.
Pathfinder
